# Al Jazeera

> Global news network providing breaking news, in-depth analysis, and multimedia journalism covering world events with focus on underreported stories from the Global South.

Al Jazeera is an international news organization offering comprehensive coverage across multiple regions including Africa, Asia, and the Middle East. The platform delivers content through various formats including live broadcasts, podcasts, and text articles, with accessibility features like automated voice narration.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Middle East Conflict
- Iran-Israel Conflict
- Geopolitics
- Human Rights
- Africa Coverage
- Asia Pacific News
- Podcasts
- Live Updates
- News Analysis
- Armed Conflict
- Humanitarian Crisis
- Refugee Migration
- Public Liberties
- The Take

## News Hubs & Breaking Coverage

- [Breaking News, World News and Video from Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com): Al Jazeera homepage with breaking news, analysis, and multimedia content.
- [Africa News | Today's latest from Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/africa): Al Jazeera's Africa news hub with latest developments and regional coverage.
- [Asia News | Today's latest from Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/asia): Al Jazeera's Asia news hub with breaking updates and regional reporting.
- [Asia Pacific | Today's latest from Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/asia-pacific): Al Jazeera's Asia Pacific news hub covering Japan, Australia, and region.

## Audio & Podcasts

- [Podcasts | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts): Al Jazeera podcast hub featuring The Take, Hindsight, and other shows.
- [The Take | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/the-take): Daily award-winning news podcast hosted by Malika Bilal.
- [The Inside Story Podcast | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/the-inside-story-podcast): Podcast analyzing and defining major global news stories.
- [Hindsight | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/hindsight): Award-winning docudrama podcast exploring historical figures and events.
- [Centre Stage | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/centre-stage): Interview podcast with thought leaders discussing world issues.
- [True Crime Reports | Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/podcasts/true-crime-reports): Investigative true crime podcast focusing on global south stories.
- [Listen Live to Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/audio/live): Live audio broadcast stream from Al Jazeera news network.

## Human Rights & Public Liberties

- [Human Rights & Public Liberties](http://liberties.aljazeera.com/en): Al Jazeera's human rights and public liberties coverage hub.

## Optional & Accessibility

- [Articles Generated by Automated Voice](https://www.aljazeera.com/articles-generated-by-automated-voice): AI text-to-speech accessibility feature for Al Jazeera articles.
